subject: User confirmation and scope refinement recorded: Gemini video gets only clip-relevant active sources
body:
Direct human follow-up after reviewing Bellglass: Ziggy confirms the dog and bark-like head motion; the dog mouth did not move, a minor defect. He accepts notebook source-context contribution and asks that scene/storyboard details be used alongside the immediate prompt. His next direct refinement is surgical clip scope: load/activate only material pertinent to the exact short clip, not a whole ten-minute scene. Keep the full story/master separately. Carry the relevant approved excerpt plus necessary continuity, actor direction, lighting, camera and background; verify actual active sources and repeat critical requirements in the prompt. A fresh chat is not proof of source isolation. No guarantee every source fact appears or direct-renderer retrieval claim. Audible barking was not separately confirmed by this feedback. No regeneration is requested.

Updated CFA notebook README, START_HERE and OPERATOR_MENU pointers to the new GEMINI_CLIP_SOURCES.txt and CLIP_SOURCE_PACK.template.txt. Registered the manual Pan teaching intake and posted the bounded owner notice to claude; posted is not read/adopted. No new generation, upload or notebook/source edit. Historical RESULT.json and original MP4 are unchanged; HUMAN_REVIEW_20261014.json is the attributed append-only review. This refinement should guide existing-shot preparation; do not let broad project-source loading silently bleed other beats into short clips.
